statement: A keystone has exactly one identity: the id in data/shadow_catalogue.json and the id of its encoded entry are the same string.
rationale: The catalogue is the index and the entries are the records. If they disagree about what a thing is called, every join across them is unreliable and 'confirmed' status means nothing.
prediction: Every catalogue row with status 'confirmed' resolves to an encoded entry with the same id, and every encoded entry appears in the catalogue.

last_result.summary: all 9 confirmed catalogue ids resolve to encoded entries
